edges.label: 促使领跑节奏
edges.quote: Progress will still be relatively fast, and we can use this time to advance the science of interpretability, improve operational security and rigor at the frontier AI companies, and build models whose alignment we have much more confidence in.

edges.label: 凸显安全竞争需求
edges.quote: Rare and unexpected examples of undesirable behavior still sometimes emerge; extra time from a paced frontier would help our researchers improve our understanding of what causes these issues and develop better techniques to prevent them.

edges.label: 通过安全竞争实现
edges.quote: I’m therefore proposing a three-step plan with the goal of pacing the frontier: building AI at a balanced rate that aims to ensure its safety while still achieving its benefits and grappling with important geopolitical dilemmas.
